verdict.rationale: Composio lets platform engineers restrict sessions to specific toolkits (composio-docs-3, composio-docs-35) and create MCP servers scoped to specific toolkits and an explicit allowed_tools list (composio-docs-23), directly matching allowlist/per-tool access control for gateway-controls. Default sessions expose all toolkits unless restricted, and restriction is opt-in rather than enforced by default. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that access-control restrictions are actually enforced at runtime (e.g., denied calls for non-allowlisted tools), and no evidence of role-based or per-agent policy management beyond session/MCP-server creation parameters.
